decisive_items: diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10
CD117, DOG1, cytokeratin, CD34, smooth muscle actin, desmin, chromogranin, and CD56 were all negative
a transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells
response.rationale: S100/SOX10 positivity with negative melanocytic and GIST markers, plus epithelioid/spindle morphology and mitotic activity, best fits MPNST; GIST is excluded by CD117/DOG1 negativity.

rejected.why: CD117 and DOG1 are negative, contradicting the required immunophenotype for GIST.
